# Contracts Checklist: ISK-0005 — Coordination & Redis Capability Contracts

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for port ownership, versioned contracts, error codes, the persistence contract revision, configuration, and public compatibility impact are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ports and Ownership

- [x] CHK001 - Is the home of every port, local substitute, and adapter named, with the driver types forbidden from port signatures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, Research R3]
- [x] CHK002 - Is each port's shape (methods, parameters, results) specified, including results that are not errors, such as contention and a denied reservation? [Completeness, Data model §Ports]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the gate cover every port, so that the rule "modules reach coordination only through the gate" has no exception? [Consistency, Contract §Ownership 3, Data model §FeatureCoordination]
  - Settled in `checklist`: `FeatureCoordination` gains a `Fencing` facade.
- [x] CHK004 - Is the cache port's shape consistent across the data model, contract, research, plan, and tasks after the store-stamp change? [Consistency, Data model §Versioned cache, Contract §Versioned cache 1, Research R13]
- [x] CHK005 - Is it stated that no ISK-0001 rule, edge, or role changes, and is the new project placed under an approved pattern? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Structure Decision]

## Versioning and Compatibility

- [x] CHK006 - Is the coordination contract's version, change procedure, and review owner stated? [Completeness, Contract §Changing this contract]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the public compatibility impact stated: which surfaces the harness versions and which only the contract's version commits to? [Clarity, Contract §Changing this contract]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the `core-contracts` change bounded to compatible additions, with the other two contract packages unchanged and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the ISK-0002 contract change limited to its error code and versioning tables? [Clarity, Plan §Source Code, Tasks §Scope guard]

## Error Codes and Failure Classes

- [x] CHK010 - Does every error code have a category from ISK-0002, a safe message, and a reason for its category? [Completeness, Spec §TR-13, Contract §Error codes, Research R15]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the failure class list identical in the spec, data model, contract, and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §TR-12, Data model §Failures, Contract §Failures 2]
  - Settled in `checklist`: TR-12 now lists `authentication failed` as a class and contention as a result.
- [x] CHK012 - Is every class mapped to one code, with its triggering conditions? [Clarity, Contract §Failures 2]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the persistence-to-coordination code mapping for the PostgreSQL coordinator stated? [Completeness, Contract §Failures 2, Tasks T013]

## Persistence Contract Version 2

- [x] CHK014 - Are the version 2 changes enumerated, each with its rule number? [Completeness, Research R7, Persistence contract v2 §Version table]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the requirement that the Advisory locks rules stay unchanged measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Tasks T042]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the scope-keyed table kind, its policy expression, and its policy check stated precisely enough to implement and verify? [Clarity, Persistence contract v2 §Isolation 7, 8, Research R6]
- [x] CHK017 - Are the database objects specified completely: columns, keys, nullability, privileges, the sequence, and the reverse script? [Completeness, Data model §Database objects, Tasks T013]

## Configuration

- [x] CHK018 - Does every configuration field have a type, range, and default, with development-only values marked? [Completeness, Data model §Configuration]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the field list in TR-15 consistent with the data model's configuration table? [Consistency, Spec §TR-15, Data model §Configuration]
  - Settled in `checklist`: TR-15 now names the maximum wait, entry count, instance lease duration, and connect timeout.
- [x] CHK020 - Is the cross-field rule (maximum lease duration not below the minimum) and its error code stated? [Clarity, Data model §Configuration, Tasks T010]
- [x] CHK021 - Is it stated how "a coordinator's settings are present" is decided for Redis and for PostgreSQL, given ISK-0003 cannot make fields conditionally required? [Clarity, Research R16]

## Diagnostics Contract

- [x] CHK022 - Does every log event have a stable ID in a range of its own, a name, a level, and a trigger? [Completeness, Contract §Diagnostics]
- [x] CHK023 - Are the activity and metric names fixed? [Clarity, Contract §Diagnostics, Research R18]
